_doc: ONE-SHOT, DIGEST-PINNED waiver of interlock precondition 5 (the independent clean-row bar). Valid ONLY while the live money-core digest equals `digest` below — any money-core edit voids it, the same F2 law that binds a ledger row, so a waiver can never become a permanent global token. This file ships with the tree ON PURPOSE: the public release-proof evaluates the same gate the source did, and a bar that was waived should say so in the open.
